{{Top|leg}}
'''Hypersonic frequency chips''' were used in [[Pacnorval Defense Systems, Limited]]'s [[Sil-50 Sonic Pistol]]. Each chip was calibrated for a specific [[Species/Legends|species]], allowing the weapon to fire at a frequency that affected the species' central nervous system, causing fatigue and sleep. Hypersonic frequency chips were available for [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], and many other species. The chips cost 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
